newsitem.title: LEBANON: Solidere shares up on higher turnover.
newsitem.headline: Solidere shares up on higher turnover.

text.p: Solidere shares rose on higher turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday as A shares rose to $112.125 from Friday's $109.75 and B shares rose to $115 from $114.
Turnover in Solidere shares sharply rose to 34,374 shares from Friday's 7,722 and value was $3,865,072.5 from $833,397.
There was no trade in the shares of the four other listed companies: Ciments Libanais, Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The LISPI stock index rose 0.43 percent to 81.78 and the BLOM stock index also rose 0.19 percent to 948.11.
